name: East African Cables Plc
source: East African Cables Plc audited results announcement for the year ended 31 December 2024 (NSE filing, audited by KPMG, audit report dated 25 April 2025). KShs thousands as filed, stored in KES. Operating Expenses is the sum of factory, administrative and selling and distribution expenses plus depreciation and amortisation and the net impairment charge, so gross profit plus other income less operating expenses equals Results from Operating Activities. Income Tax is the tax credit for the year.
source_note: Figures read from the consolidated statement of profit or loss in the audited 2024 results announcement. Revenue 2,566,273; Cost of sales (1,810,390); Gross profit 755,883; Other income 12,617; Factory (159,661); Administrative (331,594); Selling and distribution (98,352); Impairment (29,537); Depreciation and amortisation (190,032); Results from operating activities (40,676); Net finance costs (495,753); Loss before income tax (536,429); Income tax credit 177,667; Loss for the year (358,762); basic and diluted EPS KShs (0.98). Identities tie: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit; loss before tax less the tax credit equals the loss for the year.

Operating Expenses
rows.derived_from: sum of printed Factory Expenses + Administrative Expenses + Selling and Distribution Expenses; ties exactly to the printed (Loss)/Profit before Depreciation, Impairment and Finance Costs (-19,722 / 229,015)
rows.source: Operating expenses summed from the printed components of the East African Cables Plc audited results for the year ended 31 December 2023: factory expenses plus administrative expenses plus selling and distribution expenses. FY2023 710,699 = 152,740 + 459,413 + 98,546. FY2022 466,393 = 153,806 + 231,349 + 81,238. Ties to the printed (Loss)/Profit before Depreciation, Impairment and Finance Costs of (19,722) and 229,015: gross profit plus other income less operating expenses.

rows.label: ROE (%)

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedFrom: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
